language.hint: This changes the app language on this device. Report text you write is not translated.

auth.continueSubtitle: We’ll sign you back into the account linked to this number. If it’s your first time, an account is created automatically — no password required.
auth.phoneSubtitle: Enter your mobile number to receive a one-time verification code by SMS. No password needed.
auth.otpSubtitle: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS.
auth.otpExpired: This code has expired. Request a new one to continue.
auth.nationalHelper: Enter the national mobile number for {name} (without the +{code} prefix), or a full E.164 number like +{code}70123456.
auth.nationalHelperFallback: Enter a national mobile number for the selected country, or a full E.164 number like +96170123456.
auth.phoneHint: National number for {name}, or full international number
auth.phoneHintFallback: National or full international phone number
auth.countryHint: Opens the list of countries and dialing codes
auth.selectCountryHint: Search by country name, ISO code, or dialing code. Each country keeps its own ISO region even when dialing codes are shared.

more.title: More
more.signOutBody: Clear your in-progress report draft on this device, or keep it for the next time you sign in with this account.

home.heroBody: Report what needs attention and follow the municipality’s response from one place.
home.signInCreate: Sign in or create an account
home.phoneHint: A verified phone number is only needed when you submit.
home.reportHint: Photo, location, and a few details
home.refreshFailedBody: Your reports are safe. Try again when you’re connected.
home.emptyBody: When you report an issue, its progress will appear here.

profile.empty: No profile is available for this session.
profile.unableLoad: Unable to load your profile. Please sign in again.
profile.unableRefresh: Unable to refresh your profile right now.
profile.offlineSuffix: Showing the last saved profile on this device.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.lede: Review your identity, communication preferences, and public attribution settings. Full name is optional — a verified phone is enough to submit reports.
profile.fullNameHint: Optional. Not used for sign-in, recovery, ownership, or reporting.
profile.emailHint: Optional for notifications only — not used to sign in or recover your phone.
profile.publicNameHint: Defaults off. Changes apply dynamically to existing and future owned reports.
profile.editLede: Update your optional name, optional email, notifications, and public-name visibility. A verified phone is enough to submit reports.
profile.editNameHelp: Optional. Not required to sign in, recover your account, own tickets, or submit reports.
profile.editEmailHelp: Email is optional for notifications only. It is not used to sign in or recover your phone.
profile.publicNameHelp: When enabled and a full name is set, your current full name appears on owned reports. Without a name, reports stay anonymous (Community member). Default is off.
profile.phoneChangeSuccess: Phone updated to {phone}. Your session was refreshed.
profile.changePhoneBody: Your current verified phone is {phone}. Enter a new number and verify it with a one-time code. If that number already belongs to another citizen, the change will be rejected.
profile.newPhoneHint: We will send a verification code to the new number. Codes and session tokens are never shown here.

statusMeaning.SUBMITTED: Your report was received and is in the queue for review.
statusMeaning.UNDER_REVIEW: A staff member is reviewing the report before it is routed.
statusMeaning.ASSIGNED: A department has taken ownership of this report.
statusMeaning.IN_PROGRESS: The assigned team is actively working on the issue.
statusMeaning.RESOLVED: The issue has been marked resolved.
statusMeaning.unknown: Status details are not available right now.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFound: We could not find that report.

report.stepDetailsSubtitle: Tell us about an infrastructure problem in your area. It only takes a minute.
report.stepPhotoSubtitle: A clear photo helps crews confirm and prioritize the issue.
report.stepLocationSubtitle: We use this to route your report to the right department.
report.stepReviewSubtitle: Make sure everything looks right, then send it in.
report.draftSaveFailed: Could not save your draft on this device. You can keep editing, but progress may be lost if you leave.
report.draftPhotoExpired: Your saved photo is no longer available on this device. Choose a photo again, then continue.
report.draftPhotoExpiredUploaded: Your saved photo is no longer available on this device. Choose a photo again, then continue. A photo was already uploaded for this attempt — you can resubmit without re-picking, or attach a new photo.
report.draftRestoredUploaded: Draft restored. Your photo was already uploaded securely, so you can submit without attaching it again.
report.draftRestoredNoPhoto: Draft restored, but no local photo was saved. Attach a photo again before submitting.
report.draftRestored: Draft restored. You can continue or discard it.
report.discardBody: This clears the saved report draft on this device. You cannot undo this.
report.mockMode: Mock mode is enabled. Submissions return a sample ticket without calling the backend.
report.unfinishedSaved: An unfinished report is saved on this device.
report.photoSaved: Your photo is saved for this draft. Submit again to finish sending the report.
report.signedInNamed: {name} is signed in by verified phone. Contact details are taken from your profile.
report.signedInPhone: You are signed in by verified phone. Contact details are taken from your profile.
report.describeHelper: Describe the issue in plain language — a pothole, broken streetlight, waste pile, water leak, and so on.
report.describePlaceholder: e.g. Large pothole blocking the right lane near the school gate.
report.photoHelper: Attach a clear photo of the infrastructure issue so crews know what to expect.
report.cameraPermission: Camera access is needed to take a photo. You can choose one from your gallery instead, or enable camera access in your device settings.
report.libraryPermission: Photo library access is needed to attach a photo. Enable it in your device settings and try again.
report.pickerFailed: Something went wrong while opening the camera or gallery. Please try again.
report.locationHelper: We try to find your current location automatically. Confirm it on the map, or enter an address if that's easier.
report.gpsHint: Using your current location. You can move the pin or look up another address.
report.gpsHintCoords: Using your current GPS coordinates. You can adjust the pin if needed.
report.addressTooShort: Enter at least 3 characters before looking up an address.
report.validateMapFailed: Unable to validate that map point.
report.mapWebHint: Interactive map pins are available in the iOS/Android app. On web, use current location, address lookup, or a sample location.
report.tapMap: Tap the map to move the pin.
report.addressPlaceholder: e.g. Near AUB Main Gate, Hamra
report.orSample: Or pick a sample Beirut location:
report.reviewHelper: Check everything below before you submit. You can edit any section.
report.saveCodes: Save this number and tracking code — you'll need them to follow your report's progress.

track.title: Track a report
track.subtitle: Enter the 6-character tracking code from your submission confirmation. We look it up directly on the BaladiGuard API — no staff login required.
track.hint: Your tracking code was shown on the confirmation screen when you submitted a report.
track.emptyTimeline: No status updates are available for this report yet.
track.invalidBody: This link is missing a valid tracking code. You can still look up a report with a code from your receipt or SMS, or return home.
track.optionalSignIn: Sign in is optional. Tracking only needs a valid code from your notification. Status is shared when the code is valid—same as the track screen.
track.codeFromLink: Tracking code from the link: {code}. Choose how to continue.

nextAction.SUBMITTED: Your report was received and will be reviewed by municipal staff.
nextAction.UNDER_REVIEW: Municipal staff are reviewing the report details and category.
nextAction.ASSIGNED: The responsible department has been assigned and will plan the next step.
nextAction.IN_PROGRESS: The assigned team is working on the issue and will update the status when done.
nextAction.RESOLVED: The issue has been marked resolved. No further action is expected right now.
nextAction.CLOSED: This report is closed and kept for your records.
nextAction.unknown: Check back later for the next status update.

explore.title: Explore
explore.empty: Public reports will appear here after privacy review.
explore.emptyMap: No mappable locations in the current public results. Use the list below.
explore.subtitle: See what your community has reported and how the municipality is responding.
explore.noMatchBody: Clear the filters to see the public map and list.
explore.skippedOne: {count} public report has no usable map point and is still listed below.
explore.skippedMany: {count} public reports have no usable map point and are still listed below.
explore.clusterZoomA11y: Cluster of {count} public reports. Activate to zoom in.
explore.clusterPickA11y: Cluster of {count} public reports at the same location. Activate to choose a report.
explore.mapHint: Prefer the report list below if the map is hard to use. Clusters show only public reports. Same-location clusters open a short list so you can still choose a report.
explore.clusterSubtitle: These public reports share the same map pin. Choose one to open.

public.unableLoad: Unable to load that public report right now.
public.openMapsA11y: Open this report location in maps

history.title: My Reports
history.subtitle: Reports submitted from your signed-in account. Tap any report to see its full status timeline.
history.emptyBody: Reports you submit while signed in will appear here.
history.loadError: Unable to load your report history right now.

timeline.empty: No status history is available for this ticket yet.

feedback.prompt: Tell the municipality whether the reported issue is actually fixed. Your optional note stays private.
feedback.confirmed: You confirmed this report was fixed.
feedback.unresolved: You told the municipality this is still unresolved.
